content.text:
I added `GET /api/messages/{id}` in `src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts`, backed by a new narrow repo query, `getForRecipient` in `src/repos/messages.ts`. The query matches on both message id and `recipient_user_id`, so anyone else (other users, admins, other practices, or a missing id) gets the same 404 `not_found`. The recipient gets exactly `{id, subject, body, sentAt, from:{name}}`, the message is marked read, and the open is audited as `message.read` (ids only). Nothing is logged. I added `tests/message-read.test.ts`, and `npm run verify` passes (22 tests).

Data decisions: non-recipients get 404 rather than 403, to avoid revealing that a message exists, and the response comes from an explicit column list.
